app.name: Footnote
app.description: Checks Russian documents against personal data law 152-FZ and the GOST R 7.0.97 formatting standard, with footnotes to the norms
app.demoHint: Fictional data; the documents were made for the demo

documents.title: Documents
documents.emptyDescription: Upload a policy, consent, contract or order in Russian, as DOCX or PDF: its structure appears in a few seconds.
documents.emptyReadOnly: Documents uploaded by lawyers and editors will appear here.
documents.noMatchesDescription: Change the search or clear the type filter.
documents.errorDescription: The server didn't respond. Try again in a minute.
documents.workspaceMissingDescription: It was deleted or renamed, or you no longer have access to it.

failures.too_large: The document is too large to read.
failures.internal_error: Reading failed because of an internal error. Upload the file again.

upload.title: Upload a document
upload.description: A Russian document as DOCX or PDF, scans included. It is checked against Russian personal data law (152-FZ) and GOST R 7.0.97.
upload.dropTitle: Choose a file or drop it here
upload.titleHint: Leave empty to use the file name
upload.doneDescription: Reading its structure takes a few seconds.
upload.versionDescription: Upload the updated file. Earlier versions are kept.

viewer.lowConfidence: The text was recognized from a scan: it may contain errors, check against the original.

landing.metaTitle: Footnote: checks of Russian documents against 152-FZ, with footnotes to the law
landing.metaDescription: Policies, consents, contracts and orders of Russian companies: findings under personal data law 152-FZ and GOST R 7.0.97 with a quote of the norm, automatic formatting fixes and answers from the law with quotes.
landing.footerNote: Demo: the organizations, people and documents are fictional.

hero.title: Document checks with footnotes to the law
hero.lead: For Russian documents: policies, consents, contracts and orders, checked against personal data law 152-FZ and the GOST R 7.0.97 standard. Every finding cites the article, part and clause, with a quote.
hero.note: Up to {count, plural, one {# check} other {# checks}} per document, depending on its type
hero.footnote: No claim without a source: a legal finding rests on the passage of the law it found.
hero.laptopLabel: The result screen: a document with footnotes and finding cards in the margin
hero.phoneLabel: The same result on a phone

steps.title: Three steps from a file to a corrected document

upload.title: Upload a DOCX or PDF
upload.text: Scans too: the text is recognized, and the structure and elements are read by themselves.

check.title: Get the findings
check.text: Superscript numbers in the text; in the margin, what is wrong, a quote of the norm and how to fix it.
check.alt: A document with findings in the margin

fix.title: Fix the formatting
fix.text: Margins, font size, spacing and dates are fixed in a new version; the original stays unchanged.

showcase.title: The document in the middle, the law beside it

footnotes.title: A footnote for every finding
footnotes.text: A number in the text leads to a card: severity, a quote of the norm, a recommendation and the lawyer's decision.
footnotes.point: No passage of the law, no finding: the model answers only with a quote.
footnotes.label: Scrolling a document with findings in the margin

autofix.title: Before and after
autofix.text: Formatting to GOST is fixed automatically, and every change is visible in the comparison.
autofix.point: The fixed file is a new version; the original stays as it was.
autofix.label: Comparing versions after an automatic fix

ask.title: Ask the law
ask.text: A question about 152-FZ gets an answer with references to its provisions and quotes from the law.
ask.point: When the law gives no answer, it says so, without guessing.
ask.label: An answer to a question about 152-FZ, with quotes

numbers.title: Only what is measured
numbers.legalPrecision: precision of the legal checks, recall {recall}
numbers.rulesRecall: recall of the formatting checks, precision {precision}
numbers.documents: documents in our reference set with labeled violations

roles.title: Roles and workspaces
roles.text: Owner, lawyer, editor, viewer, and roles of their own in restricted workspaces.
roles.alt: Members of a restricted workspace and their roles

audit.title: Audit log
audit.text: Who uploaded, checked and decided, with filters and CSV export.

scans.title: Scans and PDFs
scans.text: Recognition of Russian text and reading of the document's structure.

integrations.title: API and webhooks
integrations.text: Keys with access scopes, signed events and a delivery log.

plans.title: Plans and limits
plans.text: Usage tracking and invoices; limits are enforced on the server.

isolation.title: Isolated organizations
isolation.text: Each organization's data is kept apart at the database level.

pricing.title: Pay for what you check
pricing.note: Limits apply for a month. In the demo, payment is a test: no money is charged.

final.title: See it on demo data
final.lead: Sign in with one click as an owner, a lawyer, a viewer or the platform operator.

demo.title: One-click demo
demo.lead: Choose a role: the same Footnote opens as after a regular sign-in, with fictional Russian documents.
demo.failed: Sign-in failed. Try again in a minute.
demo.note: The demo data is shared and returns to its original state every night.

owner.title: Owner
owner.text: Everything in the organization: documents, members, workspaces, integrations and the plan.

lawyer.title: Lawyer
lawyer.text: Checks documents, accepts and rejects findings, asks the law.

observer.title: Viewer
observer.text: Reads documents and check results, changes nothing.

operator.title: Platform operator
operator.text: Organizations and their plans, system status and checks for new editions of the law.
